claims.sentence: The main objective of this study is to demonstrate that a single anticoagulant therapy is superior to a combination of anticoagulant and antiplatelet therapy on the net clinical benefit estimated at 12 months after a Transcatheter Aortic Valve Intervention (TAVI) according to BARC2 criteria (bleeding complications; Mehran et al 2011) and VARC 3 (other complications; Kappetein et al 2012)..
